headless_factor.fit: quasi-Poisson of each step's five-hour points on account x ISO-week levels and its headless share of credits

valuation.rule: each family at the rates in force (history/model-rates.json, the pooled fit's point estimates, cache reads at its one fitted cache-read rate), except Opus 5.5, held at Anthropic's list ratio 0.8x Opus (ADR 0001 rule 23), the same rates across the whole history, so no dated regime enters a line; the ratio reads no rate but a step's headless share; each family's rate interval widens the sizes it moves (rate_dependence)

what: the four-account limit-change detector's daily runs (tracker/four_accounts.py): `runs` is one row per UTC day, what that day's run found and held; `latest` is the newest run in full, which the publisher copies into the public JSON. Accounts are named only by label. Runs up to `replayed_through` were rebuilt after the fact from the records of that day (--replay), not seen live.
